k.q: Trace this OCR ERL program; predict the output and change it.
k.code:
function area(length,width)
    return length * width
endfunction
print(area(4,3))
p: Store area(5,3) in a variable and print it.
k.a:
Original output: 12.
After the changes: Area(5,3) is 15; storing and printing it outputs 15.
